folder_html:
LIVE SURFACE PRESSURE

Hourly HRRR sea-level pressure analysis over the Great Lakes basin in hPa. The everyday average (1013.25 hPa) is the middle color so lows and highs read as departures from normal at a glance.

Sea-level pressure (hPa, HRRR analysis, fixed absolute scale): LOWEST 980 dark-blue deep low → 1000 cyan → 1006 green → AVERAGE 1013.25 yellow middle → 1017 orange → 1023 red → 1029 magenta → HIGHEST+ 1040 dark-purple. Same pressure always shows the same color; the everyday average sits in the middle. Current basin range: 1008-1025 hPa (above average (high)).

Units: hPa (hectopascals, sea-level)
